**Better newsletters: music, unsubscribe, the libraries you choose, and a new look**

- **Music from Plex and Tautulli.** New albums get their own **Music** section, with the cover, the artist and the number of tracks. It's off until you tick **Music** on a newsletter's source, so nothing changes until you choose.
- **Recipients can unsubscribe themselves.** Every newsletter has an **Unsubscribe** link, and Gmail and other mail apps show their own Unsubscribe button. Opening the link changes nothing until the person confirms.
- **Only the libraries you choose.** Each source on a newsletter has **Libraries**: all of them, or only the ones you tick. Leave out a 4K copy (no more films listed twice) or a library you keep to yourself. It applies to **Most watched** too, and a Plex server and its Tautulli keep to the same choice. A newsletter linked to both now lists each item once.
- **Designs say more, your way.** Add a highlighted notice ("Maintenance on Saturday"), rename sections ("Films"), put the day before the month, show longer summaries, and see "+ 12 more" when a section has more than it shows. Change several recipients at once, choose the group when importing users, and enjoy a new airmail look throughout, on a phone too.

Thanks to [@crispybegs](https://github.com/crispybegs) for testing every round of this release in [#439](https://github.com/jshields-ca/LatestArr/issues/439) and for the ideas behind section names, "+ N more" and longer summaries, and to [@x5nder](https://github.com/x5nder) for reporting [#483](https://github.com/jshields-ca/LatestArr/issues/483).

### Before you upgrade

- **LatestArr backs itself up before upgrading,** and migrations run automatically.
- **Newsletters keep reading every library** until you choose some. If a source has libraries your recipients can't see, open the newsletter and set its **Libraries**.
- **For a working Unsubscribe link,** recipients must be able to reach LatestArr's address (`PUBLIC_URL`, or `WEB_ORIGIN`). If it's on your home network only, you can publish just the unsubscribe page; without a reachable link, the email asks people to reply instead. See the [unsubscribe guide](https://github.com/jshields-ca/LatestArr/blob/main/docs/deliverability.md#unsubscribing).
- **"SMTP profiles" are now "Email servers"** in the app. Nothing to change.
